inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 5 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
inputs.question: Are there underground electric equipment locations (pull boxes, vaults, underground transformers) marked on the electrical design plan? If yes, are they positioned close to any of the tree locations shown on the landscape plan?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a progressive presence and proximity check—first identifying whether underground electric equipment exists on the plan, then noting whether trees are positioned close to those locations. This is a feature-identification and relative-position observation task, not a quantified distance measurement. The actual 5-foot lateral clearance measurement would come as a follow-up question.
